Ticket #1144 (adopted pacer brief): added tests/test_source_fee_whole.py, 4 tests. A Trainline fee of 1.50 makes the bahn.de fare (90.00) the main fare on the trip page, the share view and the compare view, and the ingest response best follows it; with fee 0 the Trainline fare (89.00) is main. Gap: the CSV export has no main-fare column and no fee, so the test asserts only that it keeps each price; a new ticket is needed if the owner wants the main fare in the CSV. PR #1161 merged (quick CI green). Next: quota check, then the review and roadmap slots.
